correctness.rationale: After applying scalar commutativity to seven displayed skein-presentation relations in artifacts/verify.py, the third q^2-commutator solves h uniquely (q^2+1 nonzero). The first-two difference factors into (a-c)(q^2 b+(q^2-1)^2)=0. On a=c, first relation forces a=b or a=beta. The cubic factors diagonally into s, (sq-(q+1)^2), (sq+(q-1)^2), (s q^4+(q^4-1)^2), while a=c=beta gives b=0 or gamma. On b=beta, first relation forces a=beta or c=beta and cubic gives the other coordinate 0 or gamma; excluded cyclotomic factors use q^6!=1. Source symbolic script encodes all seven scalar relations and asserts each candidate and each factorization symbolically, not just finite samples. Crucial residual: primary Theorem 32 full text was inaccessible, so the transcription of the seven defining relations could not be checked independently against its publication.
